newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Daqing gets $100 mln bank loan.
newsitem.headline: China's Daqing gets $100 mln bank loan.

text.p: Daqing General Petrochemical Works, a unit of China's state oil refiner Sinopec, has obtained a $100 million loan from a consortium of foreign banks and insurers, the Financial News said on Tuesday.

A group of 15 foreign banks and insurance firms led by Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi Ltd and Nippon Life Insurance Co of Japan extended the funds to the State Development Bank, which in turn has made the funds available to the Daqing plant.
The loan will be used for technical upgrading of an existing ethylene project at Daqing General Petrochemical Works.
Daqing, in the northeastern province of Heilongjiang, is China's biggest oilfield. It aims to boost ethylene capacity to 480,000 tonnes a year from 350,000 tonnes now.
